description: neutral means neither positive nor negative. e.g. He sat quietly, showing no particular reaction to the events around him. & The room was filled with a quiet stillness as everyone focused on their tasks.

frustration means the feeling of annoyance at impossibility from resistance or inability to achieve something. e.g. She let out a sigh and ran her fingers through her hair, feeling exasperated with the situation. & He stared at the puzzle pieces scattered on the table, unable to find a solution.

happiness means the emotion of being happy; joy; elation. e.g. A bright smile lit up her face as she received the good news. & He felt a warm glow in his chest when he saw his family gathered together.

sadness means emotionally negative and feeling sorrow. e.g. He stared out the window, his heart heavy with a lingering sense of loss. & As she walked through the empty hall, a wave of nostalgia washed over her.

anger means displaying or feeling anger. e.g. She clenched her fists and glared at him when she heard the unfair criticism. & His face turned red as he confronted the person who had betrayed his trust.

excited means having great enthusiasm, passion and energy. e.g. Her heart raced as she opened the envelope containing the results. & He couldn't sit still, eagerly anticipating the start of the event.
